@meta.@description: A schema defines the acceptable JSON structure for a given record type. When a new record is added or an existign record updated it must first pass validation against the schema to ensure it conforms to what is an acceptable record. The schema conforms to JSON Schema Draft #7.

help.title: API Documentation
help.description: Displays the home page of the TexRestAPI documentation. The documentation contains indepth descriptions of the resources available along with the endpoints used to manipulate those resources.

self.title: Schema details
self.description: A JSON Schema Draft #7 compliant description of the acceptable JSON structure for the given record type.

start.title: Home page
start.description: The home page displays a list of all registered tenants. Once a tenant is selected access to its resources is available

search.title: Retrieve all schemas
search.description: Retrieves all schemas defined for use by the supplied tenant. The schemas include system level types like users, roles, tenants and tokens as well as tenant specific types.

emu:update.title: Reload schema
emu:update.description: Reloads the schema with an updated version. When a schema is first referenced it is read into a cache and used for future requests. If the underlying EMu server is updated a nwere version of the schema may be available. The update method removes the scehma from the cache forcing the new version to be loaded when next required.

emu:update-all.title: Reload all schemas
emu:update-all.description: Forces a reload of all schemas for the current tenant. A full reload is generally required when the EMu system is updated to ensure the latest version of the schemas is available.
